info.name: Anydeo Universal Specification
info.label: Syntactic Sugar Isolation
info.description: Enforces strict canonical properties by requiring the parser to fully translate Syntactic Sugar and introduces video_original_script for traceability.

categories.label: Audio
categories.description: Voice narration, background music, and audio mixing.

categories.label: Asset Metadata
categories.description: Authorship, licensing and AI generation flags.

categories.label: Style & Effects
categories.description: Cinematic motion, transitions, text branding and effects.

asset_types.label: Image
asset_types.description: Standard static image layer. Best for backgrounds or overlays using local or uploaded files.

asset_types.label: Stock Image
asset_types.description: Intelligent search for professional photography. Describe what you need and we will find the perfect match.

asset_types.label: AI Image
asset_types.description: Generative visual creation. Turn your text prompts into unique, high-quality images for your video.

asset_types.label: Video
asset_types.description: Standard video layer. Supports local files, recordings, and direct uploads.

asset_types.label: Stock Video
asset_types.description: Search for high-quality professional video clips to enhance your project's visual variety.

asset_types.label: AI Video
asset_types.description: Generative cinematic clips. Create moving visuals from simple text descriptions.

asset_types.label: Text Layer
asset_types.description: High-quality typography with full control over style, positioning and animations. Supports standard, animated and AI-enhanced text.

asset_types.label: Talking Avatar
asset_types.description: AI-driven character that speaks your narration with realistic lip-sync and expressions.

asset_types.label: Audio / Sound
asset_types.description: Background tracks and sound effects to set the mood of your scene.

tts_models.label: MiniMax Speech 2.5 HD (WaveSpeed)
tts_models.description: State-of-the-art TTS with high-definition emotional range. Supports multiple languages and expressive styles.

avatar_models.label: Wan 2.1 S2V (Standard)
avatar_models.description: Best for static images tailored to narration.

avatar_models.label: WaveSpeed InfiniteTalk (Ultra-Fast)
avatar_models.description: High-performance digital avatar engine with extremely low latency. Powered by WaveSpeed Fast Inference.

forge_models.label: WaveSpeed Qwen Edit
forge_models.description: Precise AI Image Editing powered by WaveSpeed.

forge_models.label: Wan 2.7 T2I (WaveSpeed)
forge_models.description: High-quality text-to-image generation powered by Alibaba Wan 2.7.

video_anydeo_specification.label: Specification Version
video_anydeo_specification.description: The exact version of the specification used in this script. V_0-3-3 requires strict syntactic sugar translation and adds video_original_script.

video_name.label: Video Name
video_name.description: The main name used for the exported video and metadata.

video_resolution.label: Resolution
video_resolution.description: Determines aspect ratio and pixel dimensions.

video_status.label: Project Status
video_status.description: The current lifecycle state of the project.

video_script_source.label: Script Source File
video_script_source.description: Path to the instructions or source file used to generate the script (e.g., assets/instructions.md).

video_original_script.label: Original Script Copy
video_original_script.description: Path to the unmodified copy of the original .anydeo script, saved with an _original_{timestamp} suffix before any syntactic sugar was processed.

video_sources.label: Video Sources / Bibliography
video_sources.description: Centralized project repository of bibliographic references and media sources.

video_publish.label: Publication Integration
video_publish.description: Enables the assisted publication portal and SEO tracking.

video_publish_description.label: Publication Description
video_publish_description.description: The full description to be used when publishing. Supports metadata interpolation.

video_render_quality.label: Render Quality
video_render_quality.description: Determines the speed vs. quality tradeoff. Changing this will invalidate the scene cache.

section_title.label: Section Title
section_title.description: The heading title or identifier for this section.

scene_name.label: Scene Name
scene_name.description: Unique identifier for this specific scene.

scene_templates.label: Scene Templates
scene_templates.description: List of templates to inherit from.

scene_content.label: Content
scene_content.description: The text to be narrated by the AI voice. MUST be plain text. Markdown headers are strictly prohibited.

scene_sources.label: Scene Sources / Citations
scene_sources.description: List of citekeys or URLs providing bibliographic backing for the scene content without polluting the narration text.

scene_status.label: Scene Status
scene_status.description: The current lifecycle state of the scene.

scene_tts_model.label: TTS Model
scene_tts_model.description: The AI model used for text-to-speech generation.

scene_voice.label: Voice ID
scene_voice.description: The specific AI voice to use for narration in this scene.

scene_voice_source.label: Voice Source
scene_voice_source.description: Determines if the narration is generated via AI TTS or recorded by the user.

scene_voice_recording.label: Voice Recording
scene_voice_recording.description: Path to the user-recorded audio file.

scene_image_model.label: Scene Image Model
scene_image_model.description: Default AI model for image generation in this scene.

scene_video_model.label: Scene Video Model
scene_video_model.description: Default AI model for video generation in this scene.

scene_video_source.label: Video Source
scene_video_source.description: Determines if the scene visual is generated via AI or recorded by the user.

scene_video_recording.label: Video Recording
scene_video_recording.description: Path to the user-recorded video file.

scene_background_audio.label: Background Music
scene_background_audio.description: Path or URL to background music.

scene_duration_mode.label: Duration Mode
scene_duration_mode.description: How the scene duration is calculated.

scene_video_recording.label: Video Recording
scene_video_recording.description: Path to the user-recorded video file.

scene_duration.label: Scene Duration
scene_duration.description: The length of the scene in seconds.

scene_background_color.label: Background Color
scene_background_color.description: Solid background color rendered behind all layers.

scene_effects.label: Scene Visual Effects
scene_effects.description: Cinematic effects applied to the entire scene or its primary background.

scene_effect_speed.label: Scene Effect Speed
scene_effect_speed.description: Multiplier for the animation speed of the scene effects.

scene_visual_style.label: Scene Visual Style
scene_visual_style.description: Style key (e.g., 'photo', 'doodle') referencing a visual style defined in assets/_instructions.md.

scene_narrative_style.label: Scene Narrative Style
scene_narrative_style.description: Style key (e.g., 'energetic', 'calm') referencing a narrative style defined in assets/_instructions.md.

scene_sources.label: Scene Sources / Citations
scene_sources.description: List of citekeys or URLs corresponding to entries in the global repository or external links backing the scene narration.

layer_name.label: Layer Name
layer_name.description: Friendly name for identifying this layer.

layer_active.label: Active
layer_active.description: If false, the layer is completely ignored by the engine and UI. Use to suppress template-provided layers.

layer_type.label: Asset Type
layer_type.description: Computational type of the asset in this layer.

layer_fit_mode.label: Fit Mode / Layout
layer_fit_mode.description: How the asset fills its layer container.

layer_text_rendering_method.label: Text Rendering Method
layer_text_rendering_method.description: The technology used to render text on this layer.

layer_text_align_horizontal.label: Horizontal Alignment
layer_text_align_horizontal.description: Horizontal alignment of the text within its container.

layer_text_align_vertical.label: Vertical Alignment
layer_text_align_vertical.description: Vertical alignment of the text within its container.

layer_text_font.label: Font Family
layer_text_font.description: The font family to use for the text.

layer_text_size.label: Font Size
layer_text_size.description: The size of the text in pixels (or relative units).

layer_text_box.label: Show Background Box
layer_text_box.description: Whether to show a background box behind the text.

layer_text_box_color.label: Box Color
layer_text_box_color.description: The color of the background box.

layer_text_box_opacity.label: Box Opacity
layer_text_box_opacity.description: The opacity of the background box.

layer_asset_source.label: Asset Source
layer_asset_source.description: URL or local path to the image/video asset.

layer_visual_style.label: Generation / Style Preset
layer_visual_style.description: Style key (e.g., 'photo', 'doodle') referencing a visual style defined in assets/_instructions.md.

layer_narrative_style.label: Layer Narrative Style
layer_narrative_style.description: Style key referencing a narrative style defined in assets/_instructions.md.

layer_crop.label: Crop / Mask
layer_crop.description: Applies a visual crop or mask to the layer (e.g., 'circle', 'rounded').

layer_crop_top.label: Crop Top
layer_crop_top.description: Percentage to crop from the top of the layer asset.

layer_crop_right.label: Crop Right
layer_crop_right.description: Percentage to crop from the right of the layer asset.

layer_crop_bottom.label: Crop Bottom
layer_crop_bottom.description: Percentage to crop from the bottom of the layer asset.

layer_crop_left.label: Crop Left
layer_crop_left.description: Percentage to crop from the left of the layer asset.

layer_generation_strength.label: Transformation Strength
layer_generation_strength.description: Intensity of the AI transformation (1-10). Higher values deviate more from the source.

layer_generation_embedded_text.label: Embedded Text Prompt
layer_generation_embedded_text.description: Text to be visually embedded into AI-generated media (e.g. signs, shirts).

layer_generation_embedded_text_style.label: Embedded Text Style
layer_generation_embedded_text_style.description: Visual style prompt for the embedded text (e.g. 'neon green script').

layer_effect_speed.label: Effect Speed
layer_effect_speed.description: Multiplier for the animation speed of the layer effects.

layer_asset_is_ai.label: AI Generated
layer_asset_is_ai.description: Flag indicating if the asset was generated using AI.

layer_asset_raw_url.label: Raw URL
layer_asset_raw_url.description: The original source URL before processing or local storage.

layer_asset_author.label: Asset Author
layer_asset_author.description: The creator or owner of the asset.

layer_asset_source_service.label: Source Service
layer_asset_source_service.description: The service or platform where the asset was obtained (e.g., Replicate, Pexels).

layer_asset_citation_key.label: Citation Key
layer_asset_citation_key.description: Reference key (citekey) pointing to an entry in the project's global video_sources repository.

layer_asset_access_date.label: Access Date
layer_asset_access_date.description: The date and timestamp when the asset was accessed or downloaded.

model_manifest_schema.description: Required shape for model manifest files in model_registry/. Each JSON file defines one AI model.

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown in the UI

provider.description: API provider name, e.g. heygen, elevenlabs

api_model_id.description: The exact model ID string sent to the API

parameters.description: Property definitions for this model's parameters, following the VUS property schema shape

property_set_schema.description: Shape of a named property set in the project data. Sets are reusable bundles of property values that templates can include.

name.description: Unique name for this set within the project

properties.description: Key-value property values in this set
